test_cases.title: Logout clears token, header, and redirects to Login
test_cases.given: user is authenticated and on the Settings screen
test_cases.then: userApi.logout() is called, then props.onLogout() fires, isAuthenticated becomes false, and the Login screen renders

test_cases.title: logout() removes auth_token from localStorage and clears axios Authorization default
test_cases.given: a valid JWT is present under localStorage key auth_token and axios default Authorization header is set
test_cases.then: clearAuthToken() is called exactly once, localStorage.getItem('auth_token') returns null, and axios.defaults.headers.common.Authorization is unset

test_cases.title: logout() performs no HTTP call
test_cases.given: an authenticated session with a network request spy installed
test_cases.then: zero HTTP requests are made and logout() returns undefined synchronously

test_cases.title: Post-logout direct navigation to a protected route redirects to Login without exposing data
test_cases.when: user navigates directly to a protected route URL or presses browser back
test_cases.then: the app rejects the attempt, no protected data renders, and the user is redirected to the Login screen

test_cases.title: No leftover auth artifacts remain in browser storage after logout
test_cases.given: user was authenticated with token and any session artifacts present
test_cases.then: localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookies contain no auth token, session id, or cookie related to the prior session

test_cases.title: Logout observability event logs timestamp only, no user id or token
test_cases.then: console.log is called with 'auth:logout' and a payload containing exactly { timestamp } — no user id, email, or token value present

test_cases.title: Double-invocation of logout() is idempotent and error-free
test_cases.when: logout() is called twice in rapid succession
test_cases.then: no error is thrown, auth state ends cleared, and only harmless duplicate callback invocations occur

test_cases.title: logout() tolerates localStorage.removeItem throwing
test_cases.then: logout() completes without propagating the exception, the observability event still logs, and the auth-state callback path remains available

test_cases.title: In-flight API request during logout resolves via 401 through the same unauthorized handler
test_cases.given: an API request is in flight (mocked 500ms delay) when logout() is called
test_cases.when: logout() clears the token immediately and the in-flight request later arrives at the backend without a valid Authorization header
test_cases.then: the backend returns 401, the registered unauthorized handler fires, isAuthenticated is (still) false, and no delay is introduced to the logout redirect

test_cases.title: logout() p95 latency is under 10ms
test_cases.given: logout() is invoked in a loop of 100+ iterations with a fresh token set before each call
test_cases.when: latency of each call is measured

test_cases.title: Logout control is keyboard-operable and focus moves to Login's primary field after redirect
test_cases.given: user is authenticated on the Settings screen using keyboard only
test_cases.when: user tabs to the Logout control and activates it with Enter/Space
test_cases.then: logout proceeds and after the redirect, focus is moved to the Login screen's primary input field
